programs.description: Parbhavni Preet explores a love that defies death. With Naresh Kanodiya and Firoz Irani, this tale journeys through lifetimes, where passion, vengeance, and destiny collide in an eternal love story.
Wealthy Vikram, overprotected Siddharth and ambitious orphan Aayush join a prestigious hostel. Facing fresh challenges, the trio strives to earn a coveted spot on the wall of fame.
Parbhavni Preet explores a love that defies death. With Naresh Kanodiya and Firoz Irani, this tale journeys through lifetimes, where passion, vengeance, and destiny collide in an eternal love story.
